Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for the context — I reviewed the PO and NutriWell's asks. Quick notes:
1) Legal / tax: We can accept a dual-invoice arrangement. Recommended wording to add to the Order Form (suggestion for Appendix A):
   "Where Customer provides multiple remittance entities, Redwood will issue separate invoices to each remittance entity identified on the Order Form. Each invoice will carry the payment terms applicable to the remittance entity as specified in the Order Form. Tax treatment (including reverse-charge) will be handled in accordance with the invoiced entity's local tax law; Customer shall provide applicable tax registrations and hold Redwood harmless for Customer's failure to provide valid tax data."

2) Minimum commit attribution: Operationally acceptable to pro-rate commit across entities if consumption is mapped to line items tied to an entity. However, this creates reporting and discounting complexity. Suggest we add a short paragraph that:
   - Specifies method (USD equivalent by invoice)
   - Requires monthly reporting that consolidates consumption toward the commit

3) Net terms mismatch: We prefer avoiding mixing materially different payment terms across invoices on the same contract because it complicates remedies and interest calculations. If NutriWell insists on Net 45 for EU and Net 30 for US, we should add language specifying which late-payment remedies apply per invoice and that credits/offsets are invoice-specific.

I will prepare a redline for Appendix A and a short paragraph on commit attribution. Karthik — once you confirm we can map usage to remit entities in billing, I will finalize.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts

Marissa / Kimberly — quick operational confirmation: our billing stack supports multiple remit entities on a single order form as long as each SKU/line item is tagged to an entity. Pro-rating the minimum commit is feasible if we record consumption per entity and then sum USD equivalents monthly to evaluate commit attainment. Notes:
- We need PO numbers for each remit entity to attach to invoices.
- For reporting/discount calculations, we'll produce a consolidated monthly statement that shows per-entity invoices and an overall commit progress summary.
- Edge case: if one entity exhausts its budget early and stops paying, collection / service suspension will be done at the invoice level per the late-payment clause.

I will work with Billing to prepare the invoice template and will attach the template to the redline appendix Kimberly prepares.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
